procedure_column: Yu+etal2005 | PerkinElmer ELAN DRC II | Univ Cambridge

Coupling Description.cell: ICP-AES measured initial Ca concentration; sample then diluted to 100 ppm Ca for Q-ICP-MS analysis; ICP-AES performed first (stated section 2)
Coupling Description.value: ICP-AES measured initial Ca concentration; sample then diluted to 100 ppm Ca for Q-ICP-MS analysis; ICP-AES performed first (stated section 2)

Target Material.cell: foraminiferal calcite — core-top Cibicidoides wuellerstorfi from the north Atlantic Ocean (§4)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Aliquot of dissolved foraminiferal calcite -- "Ten to twenty individual foraminifera tests were handpicked"; cleaned samples "dissolved in 200 ul 0.075M HNO3", then split (20 ul for [Ca] by ICP-AES, remainder for ICP-MS)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Aliquot of dissolved foraminiferal calcite -- "Ten to twenty individual foraminifera tests were handpicked"; cleaned samples "dissolved in 200 ul 0.075M HNO3", then split (20 ul for [Ca] by ICP-AES, remainder for ICP-MS)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Ten to twenty tests handpicked, crushed gently, cleaned of clays (water, methanol) and silicates, reductively and oxidatively cleaned, rinsed twice in 0.001 M HNO3 and dissolved in 200 µl 0.075 M HNO3. 20 µl diluted for Ca by ICP-AES, the remainder diluted to 100 ppm Ca — §2
Sample Preparation Method.value: Ten to twenty tests handpicked, crushed gently, cleaned of clays (water, methanol) and silicates, reductively and oxidatively cleaned, rinsed twice in 0.001 M HNO3 and dissolved in 200 µl 0.075 M HNO3. 20 µl diluted for Ca by ICP-AES, the remainder diluted to 100 ppm Ca

Digestion Step.cell: dissolution (200 µl 0.075 M HNO3) — §2; the paper does not call it a digestion

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 0.075 M HNO3 at 100 ppm Ca — §2; working standards diluted with the same acid

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: Ten to twenty tests, about 300 µg of shells — §2; one measurement uses 250 µl at 100 ppm Ca, equivalent to 60 µg calcite
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: Ten to twenty tests, about 300 µg of shells

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: PerkinElmer -- "a Perkin-Elmer Elan DRC II instrument"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: PerkinElmer -- "a Perkin-Elmer Elan DRC II instrument"

Instrument Model.cell: PerkinElmer Elan DRC II (stated section 2 and Table 1)
Instrument Model.value: PerkinElmer Elan DRC II (stated section 2 and Table 1)

Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configurat.cell: N — an Elan DRC II; no cell gas or cell mode is described

Detector Configuration.cell: Pulse counting for all isotopes — Table 1; 'We determined all isotopes using pulse mode to avoid the need for cross calibration' (§3.1)

Nebulizer Type.cell: Glass Expansion Micromist FM005 (stated section 2 and Table 1)
Nebulizer Type.value: Glass Expansion Micromist FM005 (stated section 2 and Table 1)

Sample Uptake Rate.cell: ~60 uL/min (stated Table 1; 0.03 mm ID pump tubing)
Sample Uptake Rate.value: ~60 uL/min (stated Table 1; 0.03 mm ID pump tubing)

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- quartz cyclonic spray chamber and "glass micro-concentric nebulizer Micromist FM005 ... producing an uptake rate of ~60 ul/min at a pump rate of 12 rpm"; Cetac ASX100 autosampler
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- quartz cyclonic spray chamber and "glass micro-concentric nebulizer Micromist FM005 ... producing an uptake rate of ~60 ul/min at a pump rate of 12 rpm"; Cetac ASX100 autosampler

ICP Tuning.cell: "The instrument sensitivity was optimized daily using a 10 ppb Mg-In-U standard"; "Plasma robustness was monitored by constraining CeO/Ce ratio within 3% to refrain formation of polyatomic oxides"
ICP Tuning.value: "The instrument sensitivity was optimized daily using a 10 ppb Mg-In-U standard"; "Plasma robustness was monitored by constraining CeO/Ce ratio within 3% to refrain formation of polyatomic oxides"

Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.cell: Cone conditioning with pure Ca solution (100 ppm) for 0.5–1 hours before optimisation — §3.4; blanks stable over a typical run of ~5 hr (§3.2)
Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.value: Cone conditioning with pure Ca solution (100 ppm) for 0.5–1 hours before optimisation

Target Species.cell: Li, B, Mg, Al, Mn, Zn, Sr, Cd, U — as element/Ca ratios; Ca is the denominator

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Li/Ca, B/Ca, Mn/Ca, Zn/Ca, Cd/Ca (µmol/mol); Mg/Ca, Sr/Ca, Al/Ca (mmol/mol); U/Ca (nmol/mol) — Table 2 note a

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 7Li → Li; 11B → B; 25Mg → Mg; 46Ca → none; 27Al → Al; 55Mn → Mn; 66Zn → Zn; 87Sr → Sr; 111Cd → Cd; 238U → U — Table 1; ⁴⁶Ca for its low abundance, ¹¹¹Cd to avoid Sn on ¹¹²Cd and ¹¹⁴Cd (§3.1, §3.3)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: 7Li: 10 ms; 11B: 10 ms; 25Mg: 0.5 ms; 46Ca: 2 ms; 27Al: 0.5 ms; 55Mn: 0.5 ms; 66Zn: 5 ms; 87Sr: 0.5 ms; 111Cd: 60 ms; 238U: 20 ms — ms/amu (Table 1)

Number of Scans per Replicate.cell: all: 250 sweeps per reading, 1 reading per replicate — Table 1

value.value: 250 sweeps per reading, 1 reading per replicate

Analysis Sequence.cell: 8 external calibration standards, then 50–80 samples interspersed with drift correction standards every 3 samples — 6–10 hours (§3.4)
Analysis Sequence.value: 8 external calibration standards, then 50–80 samples interspersed with drift correction standards every 3 samples

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: none — element/Ca intensity ratios against matrix-matched external standards (§3)

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: CeO/Ce within 3% — 'Plasma robustness was monitored by constraining CeO/Ce ratio within 3%' (§2)

Drift Correction Method.cell: Drift monitors of intermediate concentration every 3 samples, corrected off-line by linear interpolation between two consecutive monitors — §3.4
Drift Correction Method.value: Drift monitors of intermediate concentration every 3 samples, corrected off-line by linear interpolation between two consecutive monitors

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: all: external matrix-matched standards at 100 ppm Ca, element/Ca intensity ratios on 8-point linear calibration lines — R² usually > 0.999 (§3.4)

value.value: external matrix-matched standards at 100 ppm Ca, element/Ca intensity ratios on 8-point linear calibration lines

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Average blank subtracted from the average raw intensities of 6 replicate scans — blanks in the same acid as used for dissolution and dilution (§3.2)
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Average blank subtracted from the average raw intensities of 6 replicate scans

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: N/A — all isotopes in pulse mode 'to avoid the need for cross calibration' (§3.1)

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Y — ⁴⁰Ar²⁶Mg on ⁶⁶Zn corrected off-line; ⁷Li¹⁸O, ⁴⁶Ti and ⁸⁷Rb found insignificant; HNO3 polyatomics on ⁶⁶Zn negligible (§3.3)

Interfering Species.cell: 25Mg: 7Li18O; 46Ca: 46Ti; 66Zn: 40Ar26Mg and 1H2 14N 18O 16O2+; 87Sr: 87Rb; other: N — Table 1 note c

Interference Correction Method.cell: 66Zn: off-line correction, 66Zn/46Ca corrected = measured − CF × 25Mg/46Ca measured, with CF = (K1 − K2)/(K3 − K4) from the slopes of Mg and Zn serial standards; 25Mg, 46Ca, 87Sr: none, found insignificant; other: N — Eqs 1–2, §3.3

value.value: off-line correction, 66Zn/46Ca corrected = measured − CF × 25Mg/46Ca measured, with CF = (K1 − K2)/(K3 − K4) from the slopes of Mg and Zn serial standards

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: Longer washout and uptake times for B, and a quartz spray chamber to reduce B blanks — §2, §3.2
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: Longer washout and uptake times for B, and a quartz spray chamber to reduce B blanks

Uncertainty Level.cell: RSD% -- "RSD% (relative standard deviation) = [SD of measurements/average ratio]*100%"
Uncertainty Level.value: RSD% -- "RSD% (relative standard deviation) = [SD of measurements/average ratio]*100%"

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: Zn/Ca: argide correction factor CF calculated daily from one Mg and one Zn standard, typically ~0.002; other: slopes and intercepts of the calibration lines — §3.3, §3.4

value.value: argide correction factor CF calculated daily from one Mg and one Zn standard, typically ~0.002
slopes and intercepts of the calibration lines

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- number of replicate analyses stated per ratio (n = 120, 88, 32, 70, 50). No acceptance or rejection rule stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- number of replicate analyses stated per ratio (n = 120, 88, 32, 70, 50). No acceptance or rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of n replicate analyses of each standard — Table 2 notes

value.value: average of n replicate analyses of each standard

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: Natural isotopic abundances used to select isotopes and derive correction factors: the Li standard "was artificially depleted of 7Li (92.32% vs 92.48% for natural)"; "The natural abundance of 11B (80.17%) is also different from values of foraminiferal samples which are expected to be 80.40-80.43% if assumed to have d11B ratios of 25-27 permil", giving "correction factors (0.9983 for Li and 0.9968-0.9971 for B)"; 111Cd 12.8%, 112Cd 24.1%, 114Cd 28.7%, 238U 99.3%
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: Natural isotopic abundances used to select isotopes and derive correction factors: the Li standard "was artificially depleted of 7Li (92.32% vs 92.48% for natural)"; "The natural abundance of 11B (80.17%) is also different from values of foraminiferal samples which are expected to be 80.40-80.43% if assumed to have d11B ratios of 25-27 permil", giving "correction factors (0.9983 for Li and 0.9968-0.9971 for B)"; 111Cd 12.8%, 112Cd 24.1%, 114Cd 28.7%, 238U 99.3%

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [all: gravimetric multielement stock standards, a 10,000 µg/ml Ca standard spiked with certified 1,000 µg/ml Li, B, Al, Mn, Zn, Sr, Cd and U solutions, diluted with 0.075 M HNO3 to 100 ppm Ca] — §2; minor elements in the Ca standard measured by ICP-AES

value.value: gravimetric multielement stock standards, a 10,000 µg/ml Ca standard spiked with certified 1,000 µg/ml Li, B, Al, Mn, Zn, Sr, Cd and U solutions, diluted with 0.075 M HNO3 to 100 ppm Ca

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: 8 calibration standards per run, drift monitors every 3 samples — §3.4
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: 8 calibration standards per run, drift monitors every 3 samples

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: N — precision and accuracy are assessed on external standards of known ratio (Table 2); core-top results are compared with published data (Table 4)

Detection Limit.cell: Li/Ca: 0.5; B/Ca: 15; Mg/Ca: 0.03; Al/Ca: 0.05; Mn/Ca: 0.3; Zn/Ca: 0.05; Sr/Ca: 0.02; Cd/Ca: 0.005; U/Ca: 0.5 — in the units of the ratio (Table 2)

Detection Limit Method.cell: all: 3 × SD/m, with SD of several measurements of a sample whose ratio is close to the blank and m the calibration slope — Table 2 note b

value.value: 3 × SD/m, with SD of several measurements of a sample whose ratio is close to the blank and m the calibration slope

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Cetac ASX-100 autosampler; auto lens on; 0.03 mm ID pump tubing at 12 rpm; Ca matrix effects tested over 60–240 ppm Ca (Table 1, §2, §3.5)
Additional Notes.value: Cetac ASX-100 autosampler; auto lens on; 0.03 mm ID pump tubing at 12 rpm; Ca matrix effects tested over 60–240 ppm Ca (Table 1, §2, §3.5)
